searchText: are we still doing this? LH never implemented the proposer-equivocation changes in `get_proposer_head`, and right now it seems unnecessary given how niche its applicability is without the `on_proposer_slashing` fixes Prysm already does what's on my PR, so if it merges it'll be what we already do, if it doesn't merge we may not be spec compliant. I guess it doesn't really matter that much and it's not urgent, but perhaps a decision should be made on this cc <@592004585506340885> and <@586161934425128960> you guys have write access to the spec, if it's not merged then it should be closed. in principle the change looks good to me, I just haven't gotten around to review it in detail and implement in lodestar, still planning to do that though I can review thoroughly next week as well, the approach seems sound
